slot.intent: The scheme ran in four steps, each one named in turn: the loan, the shell company, the transfer, and last the silence, where it lands.

concept: The steps are walked along one hairline: each ring is reached as its step is named and the walked ones step back; the last ring waits hollow in red until the line slows into it on "silence".
storyboard: 0.4 s, on "First": a pale hairline draws left to right through four hollow rings; the first ring fills off white and grows a touch as FIRST settles above it in grey tracked caps
1.3 s, on "loan,": The loan has built under the first ring a word at a time, each word grey settling to off white

2.5 s, after "second": SECOND has settled over the second ring and the off white line draws toward it at a steady pace; the first step has stepped back, ring smaller and grey, name smaller in mid grey
3.2 s, on "shell": the line reaches the second ring, which fills off white and grows as The shell company builds beneath it
6.4 s, on "fourth": the fourth ring turns into a hollow red ring and waits as the line sets off toward it; the first two steps sit pale, the third in mid grey
7.6 s, on "silence.": the line slows into the red ring, which fills red as it lands; silence arrives in off white as a red highlighter wipes behind it, and the walked line steps back to grey
Then a full hold to the end: the walked steps and their line quiet in grey, only the last ring and its word marked in red.

leansOn.why: One hairline joins the steps; each lights as it is named, the walked ones step back to grey, the last lands in red with its word marked.
